description: This file contains utility functions for applying JSON diffs to database tables, including methods for updating individual tables and lists based on JSON objects, with support for validation and deny lists.

classes.name: DbDiffUtils
classes.description: An internal object providing utility functions for diffing and updating database tables based on JSON data.

methods.name: diffAndUpdateTable
methods.description: Applies JSON diff to a table, updating, inserting, or deleting items based on JSON content.

methods.name: diffAndUpdateListTable
methods.description: Applies JSON diff to a map of lists, replacing entire lists based on JSON data.

methods.name: diffAndUpdateListTable
methods.description: Replaces an entire list in the database based on JSON array data.
